description: Amending the Universities Act, No.16 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-06-16 to amend the Universities Act No.16 of 1978. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. The proposed amendments to the Universities Act No.16 of 1978 will enable to create a merit-based selection process by expanding the criteria with regard to the qualifications for appointment to the post of Dean. The proposed amendments are intended to broaden the pool of eligible candidates for key academic administrative positions in the university system, thereby strengthening institutional governance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
